## REQ-LIC-001

**Provider responsible for license compliance**

The provider of a service (container image) ensures the compliance with the software licenses of all third-party software it contains.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: service-container · Applies to: manufacturer
- Refs: RIG 5.3, RIG 1.3
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: RIG-5.3-8bb5e94e

> It is in the full responsibility of the provider that compliance with the associated software licenses must be fulfilled.
> — RIG 5.3

> Independent of the compliance level, the provider is responsible for the compliance with the associated software licenses and the applicable law (5.3 Legal Requirements & Software Licenses).
> — RIG 1.3

## REQ-LIC-002

**Every license listed in the SBOM with its license text**

Every license used within a service is listed in the SBOM and the corresponding license text is provided; both are stored in the image under /opt/oi4/licenses (REQ-CNT-013, REQ-CNT-014).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: service-container · Applies to: container-image
- Refs: RIG 5.3, RIG 4.1.4, RIG 1.3, SF-092
- Verification: d8, manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: RIG-5.3-b3b4f4ea, RIG-5.3-f204a8cb

> Every license used within a service must be listed in a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), and the corresponding license texts must be provided.
> — RIG 5.3

> Providing the SBOM is mandatory from OEC Service Container Compliance Level 2 on
> — RIG 5.3

Notes: Detail of REQ-CMP-028 (reviewed umbrella). RIG 5.3 cites RIG 1.3 for the level since SF-092 (b) was resolved. D8 can check that every license of the SBOM has a text; whether the SBOM is complete needs a manual assessment.

## REQ-LIC-003

**Third-party patents and IP covered by agreements**

Procedures and techniques used within a service that are protected by a patent or intellectual property not belonging to the service provider are covered by a valid patent usage or license agreement.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: service-container · Applies to: manufacturer
- Refs: RIG 5.3, RIG 1.3
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: RIG-5.3-5a1d6312

> Utilized procedures and techniques within the services protected by any patent or intellectual property that does not belong to the service provider must be covered by a valid patent usage or licence agreement.
> — RIG 5.3

## REQ-LIC-004

**Lawful operation, no harmful or abusive components**

A service operates only within the boundaries of the applicable law and neither supports unethical tasks nor contains harmful or abusive components (such as crypto miners, spyware, trojan horses or viruses).

- Keyword: MUST NOT
- Levels: L1 MUST NOT · L2 MUST NOT · L3 MUST NOT
- Domain: service-container · Applies to: container-image, manufacturer
- Refs: RIG 5.3, RIG 5.2, RIG 1.3, SF-092
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: RIG-5.2-508f5f90, RIG-5.3-83aa82cc

> The offered services may only operate within the boundaries of the applicable law and must not support unethical tasks, like crypto-mining or spy software.
> — RIG 5.3

> Independent of the compliance level (1.3 OEC Service Container Compliance), services offered by applications must follow legal guidelines and must not contain harmful or abusive components (such as crypto miners, spyware, trojan horses, viruses, etc.) (5.3 Legal Requirements & Software Licenses).
> — RIG 5.2

Notes: Level-independent per the RIG 1.3 note and RIG 5.2 (the item moved out of the Level 3 overview when SF-092 (c) was resolved). "may only operate within the boundaries" is a restriction, not a permission.
